notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes & Stability[/h3]
[b]Fixed TV startup issue:[/b] TV now properly starts in "on" state instead of defaulting to off
[b]Resolved fidget spinner crash:[/b] Applied hotfix to prevent game crashes when navigating to Channel 1
[b]Channel 3 Dog animation improvements:[/b] Fixed positioning and animation glitches affecting dog

[h3]UI/UX Improvements[/h3]

[b]Enhanced main menu: [/b]Updated visual design and added support for additional settings options
[b]Smart TV controls:[/b] Main menu button now properly toggles TV power state when pressed
[b]Channel 2 Expanded input support:[/b] Button interactions now accept right-click, left-click, and middle-click inputs

Gameplay & Controls

[b]Channel 3 Auto-click system overhaul on progress channel:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved timing accuracy for auto-click features
[*] Resolved interference between auto-click and manual clicking
[*] Enhanced progress rate calculations
[*] Better synchronization between automated and player actions
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content: Debug keys were still registered in the final build. Have now removed them. If this has happened to you, you will need to reinstall the game. Apologize for the this issue

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content: [h1]Hotfix Log - Latest Update[/h1][h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2][h3]Core Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed stamina regeneration when player is away[/b] - Stamina now properly regenerates off channel[/p][/*][*][p][b]Corrected upgrade order and treasure mound drops[/b] - Items and upgrades now follow proper progression order[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bubble popping responsiveness[/b] - Bubbles now pop without delay[/p][/*][/list][h3]User Interface[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed Chew text display issue[/b] - Text no longer appears off-screen and is properly positioned[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed debug label from spaceship interface[/b] - Cleaned up development artifacts from production build[/p][/*][*][p][b]Corrected skill tree tab ordering[/b] - Skill tree tabs now display in the intended sequence[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gold mound subtraction - [/b]When gold is spent mound retracts[/p][/*][/list][h3]Save System & Progression[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed bubble popped counter not saving[/b] - Player progress for bubble popping now persists correctly[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed dog pet counter tracking[/b] - Pet interaction counters now save and display accurately[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill manager functionality restored[/b] - All skill management features are now operational[/p][/*][/list][h3]Pet System[/h3][list][*][p][b]Cleaned up pet evolution interface[/b] - Removed unnecessary UI elements from pet evolution screens[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][i]All fixes have been tested and are now live.
